title: Upgrade Dynamics GP Data During Cloud Migration

facts.text: Run data replication on companies to migrate before starting data upgrade.
Have the SUPER permission set and complete company setup and resolve replication errors.
Dynamics GP migration transforms data for individual companies in background tasks without disconnecting users.
On GP Migration Settings, Run migration after replication is on by default and starts transformation automatically.
Open Cloud Migration Management page, select latest successful replication run, then select Run Data Upgrade Now.
Failed Dynamics GP company upgrade cannot be restarted by selecting Run Data Upgrade Now again; must delete company and migrate again.
